title: Checking the basis of a changed promise

captions.energy: Examining the basis of assumed agreement

meaning: You can examine the basis of a changed promise and feel fairness when a new scope of agreement is discussed openly rather than attributed to earlier words.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Wheel of Fortune in the physical position appears in updating an answer after conditions change. The Tower in energy supports willingness to examine an unreliable conversational foundation: earlier agreement may no longer mean what you attributed to it. Justice in emotions brings a sense that commitments are fairly proportioned. Examining a promise’s basis need not seek someone to blame; what matters is seeing which answer you actually rely on now.

For example, you agreed to prepare a brief greeting together, but discussion later turns to a long speech before guests. The exchange changes, and you check whether the earlier “yes” applies to the new scope. **Fairness begins with the actual size of agreement**. You can recognise the idea’s appeal and separately discuss participation. Honesty is felt when agreeing to a few lines is not automatically treated as promising a speech. The new option remains possible but still needs acceptance from you both.

What sounds destructive is using clarification to prove that nothing further needs discussion. Examining the foundation then becomes a unilateral refusal to continue talking. The constructive Tower helps retain honesty in the new answer too. You can name the limit of earlier agreement and hear a fresh proposal without confusing the right to decline with a need to reject every change that appears.
